integrity: Exhaustive 32-class standard-form enumeration, direct finite-field point counts, separate fourth-extension checker. No independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: Finite field F4 and genus-three hyperelliptic 2-rank-zero stratum only. Nart-Sadornil (2004) already classified underlying isomorphism classes; the new contribution is the exact 18-polynomial Weil distribution, with residual bibliographic priority uncertainty due to inaccessible 2004 full text.
title: The eighteen Weil spectra of 2-rank-zero genus-three curves over F4
